snippet.description:
Céline Dion – The Chase (Official Lyric Video)
 
Stream it or buy it here: https://smarturl.it/CelineDionCourage
 
Subscribe to the official YouTube Channel for Celine: https://smarturl.it/CelineDionOnYouTube

Website: https://www.celinedion.com
 
LYRICS:
This is from the heart
Ready to let my guard down whatever the cost
Keeping it safe you just can’t love outside the box
So I’m going to try my luck on you
 
This is from a girl
Who still believed that there was someone in the world
To take her at her best and her worst
Won’t give up when it hurts
So I’m going to try my luck
I’m going to try my luck
Babe, I’m going to try my luck on you
 
So I wish you, I wish you’d
 
Stay
Cause there’s something about the chase
That’s got you running through my mind all day
And I can’t keep up
Cause I’m still reveling in the rush of the chase
 
This is for the one
Always walking the beat of their own drum
Ain’t afraid to take it as it comes
Yeah you want to try your luck
Do you want to try your luck on me?
 
Cause I wish you, I wish you’d
 
Stay
Cause there’s something about the chase
That’s got you running through my mind all day
And I can’t keep up
Cause I’m still reveling in the rush of the chase
I wish you’d, I wish you’d
Stay
 
I might run but won’t walk away If you keep making my heart race
Till I can’t keep up
I’ll be reveling in the rush of the chase
I wish you would
 
Keep me running, running, running
Searching for that something, something
And I think it could be
You and me
 
So Stay
Cause there’s something about the chase
That’s got you running through my mind all day
And I can’t keep up
Cause I’m still reveling in the rush
I wish you’d, I wish you’d
Stay
I might run but won’t walk away
If you keep making my heart race
Till I can’t keep up
I’ll be reveling in the rush of the chase
Oh I wish you’d, I wish you’d
 
Stay
 
Oh stay
 
Oh stay, yeah
 
Stay
I wish you would
I wish you would

 
#CelineDion #TheChase #Courage

snippet.title: Céline Dion - PARIS 2026: The Final Recap (Official HD Video)
snippet.description:
Céline Dion - PARIS 2026: The Final Recap (Official HD Video)
 
Description:
Across 16 sold-out shows at Plenitude Arena, Céline’s return brought together thousands of fans from around the world to celebrate her historic comeback. This extended recap offers a look back at the final days of the PARIS 2026 residency, featuring intimate, behind-the-scenes moments and a glimpse into the people and experiences that made the event so special.
 
Après 16 concerts à guichets fermés à la Plenitude Arena, le retour historique de Céline aura rassemblé des milliers de fans venus du monde entier. Cette rétrospective en version longue revient sur les derniers jours de la résidence PARIS 2026, entre moments privilégiés en coulisses, rencontres et souvenirs de celles et ceux qui ont fait de cet événement une expérience inoubliable.

Lyrics:
Don't think I can't feel that there's something wrong
You've been the sweetest part of my life for so long
I look in your eyes, there's a distant light
And you and I know there'll be a storm tonight
This is getting serious
Are you thinking 'bout you or us

[Chorus]
Don't say what you're about to say
Look back before you leave my life
Be sure before you close that door
Before you roll those dice
Baby think twice

[Verse 2]
Baby think twice for the sake of our love, for the memory
For the fire and the faith that was you and me
Babe I know it ain't easy when your soul cries out for higher ground
'Cos when you're halfway up, you're always halfway down
But baby this is serious (This is serious)
Are you thinking 'bout you or us

[Chorus]
Don't say what you're about to say
Look back before you leave my life
Be sure before you close that door
Before you roll those dice
Baby think twice

[Bridge]
Baby this is serious (This is serious)
Are you thinking 'bout you or us
Baby

[Outro]
Don't say what you're about to say (No no no no)
Look back before you leave my life (Don't leave my life)
Be sure before you close that door
Before you roll those dice
Baby think twice
Don't do what you're about to do
My everything depends on you (I depend on you)
Whatever it takes, I'll sacrifice
Before you roll those dice (Don't do it baby, oh don't do it baby)
Don't say what you're about to say
Look back before you leave my life (Don't leave my life)
Be sure before you close that door
Before you roll those dice
Baby think twice

#CélineDion #ThinkTwice #LiveonTopofthePopsBBC1994

snippet.title: Céline Dion - Dansons (Vidéo officielle)
snippet.description:
Céline Dion - Dansons (Vidéo officielle)

À propos du réalisateur : « Max Allouche est un jeune auteur et réalisateur de mini-séries sur Instagram qui célèbrent l’amour et les rencontres. Très actif sur les réseaux, il a proposé à différents artistes (chanteur, humoriste, violoniste, danseuse) de participer à ce clip. On peut retrouver la grande danseuse classique Victoria Dauberville et son conjoint Mathieu Forget, la violoniste Esther Abrami, l’humoriste Lola Dubini et la jeune artiste Oria entre autres »
//
About the director: Max Allouche is a young writer and director of mini-series on Instagram that celebrate love and new encounters. Highly active on social media, he invited various artists (a singer, a comedian, a violinist and a dancer) to take part in this music video. Featured artists include the renowned classical dancer Victoria Dauberville and her partner Mathieu Forget, violinist Esther Abrami, comedian Lola Dubini and the young artist Oria, amongst others.”

Victoria Dauberville - www.youtube.com/@victoriadauberville
Mathieu Forget - www.youtube.com/@Forgetmat

Dansons, au-dessus des abîmes

volons, valsons

sur un pas, sur un fil

nos mains nouées

Que rien ne nous retienne, (ne nous retienne)
 
Dansons, au-dessus des grands vides
que nos souffles nous guident
les corps à l’unisson
jouez violons
 
Dansons, ce soir il y a bal
au milieu des étoiles,

doux rendez-vous

Flocons, sur l’horizon (flocons sur l'horizon)
 
Dansons pour être et rester droits
Parce qu’on se le doit
Pour tous les immobiles
Tous les sans voix ni loi
Parce que c’est inutile
Parce que toi et moi
Nos visages, nos bras
Malgré tout puisqu’on ne peut danser que debout
 
Dansons, inventons nos vertiges
avant que l’on se fige
quand l’univers hostile
une idylle, une île
 
Dansons au-dessus des abîmes
aux arêtes des cimes
tournons puisque le monde

On peut retrouver la grande danseuse classique Victoria Dauberville et son conjoint Mathieu Forget, la violoniste Esther Abrami, l’humoriste Lola Dubini et la jeune artiste Oria entre autres »

About the director: Max Allouche is a young writer and director of mini-series on Instagram that celebrate love and new encounters. Highly active on social media, he invited various artists (a singer, a comedian, a violinist and a dancer) to take part in this music video. Featured artists include the renowned classical dancer Victoria Dauberville and her partner Mathieu Forget, violinist Esther Abrami, comedian Lola Dubini and the young artist Oria, amongst others.”

Paroles :
Dansons, au-dessus des abîmes
aux arêtes des cimes
et les bas fonds quittons
volons, valsons
 
Dansons, quand le monde vacille
sur un pas, sur un fil
à nos corps emmêlés,
nos mains nouées
 
Pour oublier nos peines
Que rien ne nous retienne, (ne nous retienne)
 
Dansons, au-dessus des grands vides
que nos souffles nous guident
les corps à l’unisson
jouez violons
 
Dansons, ce soir il y a bal
au milieu des étoiles,
envers et contre nous
doux rendez-vous
 
Flottons, front contre front
Flocons, sur l’horizon (flocons sur l'horizon)
 
Dansons pour être et rester droits
Parce qu’on se le doit
Pour tous les immobiles
Tous les sans voix ni loi
Parce que c’est inutile
Parce que toi et moi
Nos visages, nos bras
Malgré tout puisqu’on ne peut danser que debout
 
Dansons, inventons nos vertiges
avant que l’on se fige
quand l’univers hostile
une idylle, une île
 
Dansons au-dessus des abîmes
aux arêtes des cimes
tournons puisque le monde
ne tourne plus rond
